figures.shows: The Basic 3D scene with a sun of 65536 lux at manual exposure -16, then with a sun of 1 lux at manual exposure 0, the sky light off in both (so the sky is black); the two pictures are identical in every pixel
figures.caption: Two suns of very different strength, and two exposures far apart, give the same picture.
figures.alt: Two pictures of a dark stone ground with a gray cube under a black sky, lit by one sun from the right so the cube casts a hard shadow to its left. The two pictures are the same, pixel for pixel.
